classPractice.question: 健康的饮食为身体打下坚实的基础。（solid foundation）
classPractice.answer: A healthy diet lays a solid foundation for the body.
classPractice.note: lay a solid foundation for 为…打下坚实基础

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: As the temperature drops, the liquid will gradually ____ (solid).
classPractice.note: 此处需动词“凝固”，用 solidify

translation: 【课件】vi. & vt. 转变，改变（switch to）；开/关（电器、灯）；交换，调换，调班；n. 开关；转变，改变
original_sentence: In the past, acupuncture needles were made of stone or bone, but the majority have now switched to stainless steel ones.
definitionEn: to change from one thing to another; to turn a device on or off using a switch.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】开/关（电器、灯）（switch off/on）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please switch the lights off as you leave.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】交换，调换，调班（switch A with B）
uncommonMeanings.example: Do you think she'll notice if I switch my glass with hers?

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】开关；转变，改变（make the switch from A to B）
uncommonMeanings.example: She made the switch from full-time to part-time work.

posExamples.example: Press these two keys to switch between documents on screen.
posExamples.translation: 按这两个键在屏幕上的文件之间切换。

posExamples.example: When did you switch jobs?
posExamples.translation: 你什么时候换的工作？

collocations.translation: 改用不锈钢的（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
When certain shows switched to a commercial, a loud noise would sound.
Switch on the light and you can do your homework.
Do you think she'll notice if I switch my bag with hers?
They had to make a switch in their plan because of the bad weather.
You can easily switch between the two languages on this app.

synonyms.example: He changed his career at the age of forty.
synonyms.usage: vt./vi.，最通用；switch 更强调“整体切换到另一选项/彻底转换”

synonyms.example: Public attention has shifted to online health services.
synonyms.usage: vt./vi.，侧重“重心/方向的转移”；switch 侧重“换成另一个”

advancedExpressions.expression: switch to sth 转用；switch off/on 关/开；switch A with B 交换；switch between A and B 在两者间切换；make the switch from A to B 从A转变为B
advancedExpressions.example: More hospitals are making the switch from paper records to digital ones.

advancedExpressions.expression: switch 既作动词“转换/开关”，又作名词“开关；转变”，如 the light switch 电灯开关、make a switch 作出转变。
advancedExpressions.example: Reach for the light switch on the wall and turn it on.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Most doctors now use stainless steel needles instead of stone ones.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 switch to 替换 use...instead of，更简洁地道

classPractice.question: For some reason, when certain shows ____ ____ (切换到) a commercial, a loud noise would sound for a few seconds.
classPractice.note: PPT语境运用原题；switch to sth 切换到某物，过去时用 switched

classPractice.question: Do you think she'll notice if I ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (把我的包与她的交换)?
classPractice.note: PPT语境运用原题；switch A with B 把A与B交换

classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ ____ (打开灯) and you can do your homework. But don't forget to ____ ____ the light after finishing.
classPractice.answer: Switch on the light; switch off
classPractice.note: PPT语境运用原题；switch on 打开、switch off 关掉

translation: adj. 不锈的；防锈的；（尤指）不锈钢的；纯洁的，无污点的
original_sentence: In the past, acupuncture needles were made of stone or bone, but the majority have now switched to stainless steel ones.
definitionEn: (especially of steel) not easily marked, damaged, or made rusty; without a stain or fault.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书面/比喻）无污点的，纯洁无瑕的
uncommonMeanings.example: He was a man of stainless reputation.

posExamples.example: The kitchen is fitted with a stainless steel sink.
posExamples.translation: 厨房装了一个不锈钢水槽。

wordForms.meaning: 被弄脏的；着色的（stained glass 彩色玻璃）

collocations.example: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
Modern surgical tools are usually stainless steel ones.
She washed the vegetables in the stainless steel sink.

synonyms.example: The tools are coated with a rustproof material.
synonyms.usage: adj.，强调“经处理不生锈”；stainless 强调材料本身（尤指钢）不锈、不留污

advancedExpressions.expression: stainless = stain（污点/锈迹）+ -less（无…的），意为“无污点的/不锈的”；类比 spotless（无瑕的）、harmless（无害的）、priceless（无价的）。
advancedExpressions.example: The nurse kept the tray spotless and the needles stainless.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Now most needles are made of steel that does not rust.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 stainless steel 一词替换“steel that does not rust”，表达更凝练

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: Most acupuncture needles today are made of ____ (stain) steel.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词修饰 steel，stain 加 -less 构成 stainless 不锈的

classPractice.question: 如今大多数针灸师改用不锈钢针。（switch to, stainless steel）
classPractice.answer: Nowadays most acupuncturists have switched to stainless steel needles.
classPractice.note: switch to 改用；stainless steel 不锈钢

classPractice.question: The surgeon's instruments are made of ____ steel so that they will not rust. (不锈的)
classPractice.note: stainless steel 不锈钢，not rust 呼应“不锈”

translation: n. 钢，钢铁；钢铁工业；vt. 使坚强，使下定决心（steel oneself）
original_sentence: In the past, acupuncture needles were made of stone or bone, but the majority have now switched to stainless steel ones.
definitionEn: a strong hard metal made from iron and carbon, used for making tools, machines, buildings, etc.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使坚强，使下定决心（steel oneself to do/for sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She steeled herself to break the bad news to the family.

posExamples.example: The bridge is supported by huge steel beams.
posExamples.translation: 这座桥由巨大的钢梁支撑。

idioms.meaning: 钢铁般的神经；沉着冷静，无所畏惧
idioms.example: A surgeon needs nerves of steel during a long operation.

collocations.example: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
Modern surgical tools are usually made of steel.
The city grew rich on the steel industry.

collocations.translation: 使自己坚强/下定决心（做某事）
collocations.example: He steeled himself to face the difficult surgery.

synonyms.example: The gate is made of cast iron.
synonyms.usage: n.[U]，纯金属元素铁；steel 是铁与碳的合金，更硬更强，二者不可混用

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·stainless steel(合成/复合名词)
advancedExpressions.expression: stainless steel = stainless（不锈的）+ steel（钢）复合而成，指“不锈钢”；类比 waterproof（防水的）、rust-free（无锈的）。
advancedExpressions.example: Surgeons prefer stainless steel because it does not rust.

advancedExpressions.expression: steel 除名词“钢”外，可作动词“使坚强、使下定决心”，常用 steel oneself to do sth。
advancedExpressions.example: The young doctor steeled herself to tell the patient the truth.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Now the needles are made of a strong metal that does not rust.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The majority have now switched to stainless steel needles.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用专有材料名 stainless steel，比描述性短语更精确凝练

classPractice.question: Most acupuncture needles are now made of stainless ____. (钢)
classPractice.note: stainless steel 不锈钢，steel 为不可数名词

classPractice.question: 外科医生在长时间手术中需要钢铁般的神经。（nerves of steel）
classPractice.answer: A surgeon needs nerves of steel during a long operation.
classPractice.note: nerves of steel 钢铁般的神经，喻沉着冷静

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: She ____ (steel) herself to tell her family the bad news.
classPractice.note: steel oneself to do sth 使自己下定决心做某事；此处过去时 steeled

translation: 诊所；门诊部；（医院的）专科门诊
original_sentence: At an acupuncture clinic, the doctor first examines the patient before inserting the fine needles.
definitionEn: a place, often part of a hospital, where people go for medical treatment or advice, usually for a particular condition.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医院内的）专科门诊时段
uncommonMeanings.example: The eye clinic is held every Tuesday morning.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英）辅导课；咨询会
uncommonMeanings.example: The tutor runs a maths clinic for students who need extra help.

posExamples.example: She works as a nurse at a local health clinic.
posExamples.translation: 她在当地一家保健诊所当护士。

wordForms.meaning: 临床的；诊所的；冷静客观的

collocations.example: Patients line up outside the acupuncture clinic every morning.
The village has a small health clinic staffed by two doctors.
He goes to the clinic once a month to have his blood pressure checked.
Minor injuries are dealt with at the outpatient clinic.

synonyms.example: The doctor's surgery opens at eight in the morning.
synonyms.usage: 英式英语中指全科医生的诊所或坐诊时间；美式多用 clinic/doctor's office。

synonyms.example: Collect your medicine from the hospital dispensary.
synonyms.usage: 侧重配发药品的地方，比 clinic 义窄。

advancedExpressions.expression: clinic (n. 诊所) → clinical (adj. 临床的) → clinically (adv. 临床上地)
advancedExpressions.example: The new drug is still undergoing clinical trials.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: She went to the clinic to see a doctor.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She dropped by the acupuncture clinic, where a doctor examined her pulse before treatment.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 where 定语从句 + before 时间状语，把"就诊"细节化、场景化。

classPractice.question: Traditional Chinese doctors at the ____ often check a patient's pulse and tongue before making a diagnosis.
classPractice.note: clinic 指提供治疗或咨询的诊所，与后文"看病流程"呼应。

classPractice.question: 这家针灸诊所每天要接待上百名病人。
classPractice.answer: This acupuncture clinic receives hundreds of patients every day.
classPractice.note: acupuncture clinic 为话题固定搭配；receive/see patients 表"接诊"。

classPractice.question: The medicine is still being tested and has not yet passed all the ____ (clinic) trials.
classPractice.note: 空处修饰名词 trials，需用形容词 clinical"临床的"。

translation: 【课件】检查（病人、身体）；【课件】审查，调查，仔细研究；考核，测验
original_sentence: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
definitionEn: to look at or consider a person or thing carefully and in detail in order to discover something about them.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 考核，测验（in / on 某学科）
uncommonMeanings.example: The students will be examined in all subjects at the end of term.

posExamples.example: The doctor examined the patient carefully but found nothing wrong.
posExamples.translation: 医生仔细检查了病人，但没发现异常。

wordForms.meaning: 检查；审查；考试（缩写 exam）

collocations.translation: 检查病人（课件搭配 = look at sb closely）
collocations.example: The nurse examined the patient's wrist to feel his pulse.

collocations.translation: 被检查有无损坏（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: The goods were examined for damage on arrival.
It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.

collocations.phrase: be examined in / on a subject
collocations.example: The students will be examined in all subjects at the end of term.
Scientists examined the samples closely under a microscope.
Your proposals are still under examination.

synonyms.example: An officer came to inspect the machines for safety.
synonyms.usage: vt.；侧重官方或系统性地查看有无缺陷，常 inspect sth for sth。

synonyms.example: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
synonyms.usage: vt./vi.；侧重查明原因或真相，对象常是事件、案件。

synonyms.translation: 核查，检查（是否正常/正确）
synonyms.example: Remember to check your answers before handing in the paper.
synonyms.usage: vt./vi.；口语化，快速查看是否无误，常 check sth for sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: examine (vt. 检查/审查) → examination (n. 检查/考试) → examiner (主考人) / examinee (考生)
advancedExpressions.example: A medical examination report showed that he was in good health.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The doctor looked at the patient.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The doctor examined the patient carefully, checking his pulse and looking at his tongue.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 examine 替换 look at，并加分词状语呈现"望闻问切"的诊断细节。

classPractice.question: The doctor looked at the patient closely.（用 examine 改写）→ The doctor ____ the patient closely.
classPractice.note: examine = look at sb/sth closely，替换更正式，符合就诊语境。

classPractice.question: A medical ____ (examine) is required before you can join the army.
classPractice.note: 空处作"医疗检查"，用名词 examination；不定冠词 A 提示可数单数。

classPractice.question: 有必要仔细研究一下这些方案该如何实施。
classPractice.answer: It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.
classPractice.note: examine + how 从句表"仔细研究/审查"；照用课件例句结构。

translation: 舌，舌头；语言，语种（mother tongue 母语）；说话方式
original_sentence: In traditional Chinese medicine, the doctor examines the colour of the patient's tongue to judge his health.
definitionEn: the soft movable part in the mouth used for tasting, licking and speaking; also a particular language.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 语言，语种（尤指 mother tongue 母语）
uncommonMeanings.example: English is not her mother tongue, but she speaks it fluently.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 说话方式；口才
uncommonMeanings.example: She has a sharp tongue and often hurts people with her words.

posExamples.example: The doctor asked the patient to stick out his tongue for a check.
posExamples.translation: 医生让病人伸出舌头以便检查。

idioms.idiom: on the tip of one's tongue
idioms.example: Her name is on the tip of my tongue, but I just can't recall it.
He wanted to argue but decided to hold his tongue.
Calling her by the wrong name was just a slip of the tongue.

collocations.phrase: stick out / put out one's tongue
collocations.example: The doctor asked me to stick out my tongue and say "Ah".

collocations.translation: 舌苔的颜色（中医诊断话题）
collocations.example: A TCM doctor reads the colour of the tongue to check the body's condition.
Children learn their mother tongue naturally at home.

synonyms.example: Chinese is one of the oldest languages in the world.
synonyms.usage: n.；泛指语言体系；tongue 作"语言"义时更书面、多用于 mother tongue。

advancedExpressions.expression: tongue 除"舌头"外，可表"语言"(mother tongue) 与"说话方式"(a sharp tongue)。
advancedExpressions.example: Though English is not his mother tongue, he never gets tongue-tied on stage.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The doctor looked at the patient's tongue.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The doctor examined the colour of the patient's tongue to judge how his organs were working.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 补出"看舌象判断脏腑"的中医诊断逻辑，贴合本单元话题。

classPractice.question: In TCM, a doctor often looks at the colour of a patient's ____ to tell how healthy he is.
classPractice.note: "望舌"是中医诊断手段，tongue 指舌头。

classPractice.question: 他的名字就在我嘴边，可我一时想不起来。His name is ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ my tongue, but I can't recall it.
classPractice.note: on the tip of one's tongue 表"话到嘴边（想不起）"。

classPractice.question: 英语不是她的母语，但她说得很流利。
classPractice.answer: English is not her mother tongue, but she speaks it fluently.
classPractice.note: mother tongue 意为"母语"，为固定搭配。

translation: 脉搏；脉冲；（音乐等的）节拍，律动
original_sentence: The acupuncturist felt the patient's pulse at the wrist before deciding where to place the needles.
definitionEn: the regular beating of blood through the body, especially as it can be felt at the wrist or neck.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （光、电、声等的）脉冲
uncommonMeanings.example: The machine sends out a pulse of light every second.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （活动、情感等的）脉动，中心，节拍
uncommonMeanings.example: This market is the beating pulse of the whole city.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 搏动，跳动
uncommonMeanings.example: Blood pulsed through his veins as he ran.

posExamples.example: The nurse took my pulse and found it a little fast.
posExamples.translation: 护士给我量了脉搏，发现有点快。

idioms.example: The doctor felt my pulse before writing the prescription.

collocations.translation: 给某人诊脉/量脉搏（就医常用）
collocations.example: A TCM doctor feels the pulse at the wrist to check the body's condition.
Her pulse quickened as she opened the exam results.

collocations.translation: 急促的/微弱的/平稳的脉搏
collocations.example: The patient had a weak pulse and was rushed to hospital.

synonyms.example: The doctor listened to the baby's heartbeat.
synonyms.usage: n.；指心脏跳动本身；pulse 指血流在动脉处形成的可触及的搏动。

advancedExpressions.expression: feel/take sb's pulse (诊脉) → one's pulse races/quickens (脉搏加快，喻紧张激动)
advancedExpressions.example: The doctor took his pulse, which was racing with anxiety.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The doctor checked the patient's pulse.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The acupuncturist gently felt the patient's pulse at the wrist to work out which organs were out of balance.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 把"号脉"细化为中医"切脉断脏腑"，衔接本单元针灸话题。

classPractice.question: The doctor ____ my ____ before writing a prescription.（诊脉）
classPractice.note: feel / take one's pulse 表"诊脉、量脉搏"。

classPractice.question: Blood ____ (pulse) quickly through her veins as she waited for the result of the test.
classPractice.note: 此处 pulse 用作动词"搏动、跳动"，主语 blood 与 pulse 搭配自然；一般过去时。

classPractice.question: 针灸师先在手腕处号脉，然后再决定下针的位置。
classPractice.answer: The acupuncturist first felt the pulse at the wrist and then decided where to place the needles.
classPractice.note: feel the pulse at the wrist 是话题固定表达。

translation: 手腕，腕关节
original_sentence: The doctor pressed two fingers on the patient's wrist to feel his pulse.
definitionEn: the joint between the hand and the arm, allowing the hand to move and bend.

posExamples.example: She wears a smart watch on her left wrist.
posExamples.translation: 她左手腕上戴着一块智能手表。

collocations.phrase: feel the pulse at the wrist
collocations.translation: 在手腕处号脉（中医话题）
collocations.example: The TCM doctor placed his fingers on my wrist to feel the pulse.
He fell off his bike and sprained his wrist.
Patients wear a paper band on their wrist showing their name.

advancedExpressions.expression: wrist + band = wristband (护腕)；wrist + watch = wristwatch (腕表)
advancedExpressions.example: Runners often wear a wristband to wipe away sweat.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The doctor felt the pulse on the wrist.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Placing two fingers gently on the patient's wrist, the doctor felt for the pulse beneath the skin.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用现在分词状语前置，让"搭脉"动作更连贯、书面。

classPractice.question: To measure your heart rate, press two fingers on the inside of your ____ and count the beats.
classPractice.note: "手腕内侧"是测脉搏的常见部位，用 wrist。

classPractice.question: 他从自行车上摔下来，扭伤了手腕。
classPractice.answer: He fell off his bike and sprained his wrist.
classPractice.note: sprain one's wrist 表"扭伤手腕"。

classPractice.question: 中医大夫把手指按在我的手腕上号脉。The TCM doctor pressed his fingers on my ____ to feel the pulse.
classPractice.note: feel the pulse at/on the wrist 为本单元话题搭配。

translation: （人体或动植物的）器官；风琴；机构，机关；（报纸等）机关报，喉舌
original_sentence: Each acupuncture point is linked to a different organ of the body.
definitionEn: a part of the body that has a particular purpose, such as the heart or the liver; also a large musical keyboard instrument.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 风琴（乐器）
uncommonMeanings.example: She learned to play the organ in the local church.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 机构，机关；（政党等的）喉舌，机关报
uncommonMeanings.example: The newspaper became the official organ of the party.

posExamples.example: The heart is one of the most important organs in the human body.
posExamples.translation: 心脏是人体最重要的器官之一。

wordForms.meaning: 器官的；有机的；不用化肥的

collocations.example: Smoking can damage several vital organs over time.
The girl's life was saved by an organ transplant.

collocations.phrase: be linked to a different organ
collocations.translation: 与不同的器官相连（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Each acupuncture point is linked to a different organ of the body.

advancedExpressions.expression: organ (n. 器官) → organic (adj. 器官的/有机的) → organism (n. 生物体) → organist (风琴手)
advancedExpressions.example: Every living organism is made up of many working organs.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Each point is connected to an organ.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: According to acupuncture theory, each point on the body is linked to a particular organ, so treating the point can affect that organ.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 补出"穴位—脏腑—疗效"的因果链，贴合针灸话题并升级句式。

classPractice.question: The heart, the lungs and the liver are all important ____ (器官) of the human body.
classPractice.note: 指人体器官，复数 organs；空前 all 提示可数复数。

classPractice.question: Acupuncturists believe every point on the skin is linked to a different ____ (器官) inside the body.
classPractice.note: a different organ 单数可数，指身体内部某一器官。

classPractice.question: 吸烟会逐渐损害人体的多个重要器官。
classPractice.answer: Smoking can gradually damage several vital organs of the human body.
classPractice.note: vital organs 表"重要器官"，为固定搭配。

translation: 【课件】追溯到，（追溯至）始于（= date from）
original_sentence: There is evidence that acupuncture dates back to the Stone Age, when stone tools called bian were used to press areas of the body.
definitionEn: to have existed since a particular time in the past; to have its origin in a certain period.

wordForms.meaning: 追溯到，始于（= date back to）

idioms.meaning: 追溯到；始于（课件：一般不用于进行时；作后置定语时常用 -ing 形式）
idioms.example: This temple dates back to the 5th century.

collocations.phrase: date back to the Stone Age
collocations.translation: 追溯到石器时代（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: There is evidence that acupuncture dates back to the Stone Age.

collocations.translation: 追溯到，始于（= date back to）
collocations.example: The building dates from the 13th century.

collocations.translation: 可追溯到……的（课件：作定语常用 -ing 形式）
collocations.example: All these trees are over 800 years old, with some dating back to 1,000 years ago.
The exhibition contains some of his best work to date.

collocations.phrase: set / fix a date for sth
collocations.example: We need to set a date for the next meeting.

synonyms.example: The custom goes back to ancient times.
synonyms.usage: 短语动词，与 date back to 同义；主语多为传统、习俗、建筑等。

synonyms.example: The festival originated in ancient China.
synonyms.usage: vi.；侧重"起源"，后接地点用 in、来源用 from。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·同位语从句 + 非限制性定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: There is evidence that acupuncture dates back to the Stone Age, when stone tools were used ...：主句 there is evidence… 后接 that 引导的同位语从句解释 evidence；when 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明 the Stone Age。
advancedExpressions.example: There is evidence that the disease dates back to ancient times, when few cures were known.

advancedExpressions.expression: date back to = date from (追溯到)；to date (迄今为止)；set/fix a date for (为…定日期)。注意：date back to / date from 一般不用于进行时。
advancedExpressions.example: The custom dates from the Tang Dynasty, and to date it is still followed in many villages.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Acupuncture began a very long time ago.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is evidence that acupuncture dates back to the Stone Age.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 There is evidence that + date back to 使表达更客观、更书面。

classPractice.question: "Niren Zhang", or Clay Figurine Zhang, ____ (date) back to 180 years ago and is a traditional Chinese folk art originating in Tianjin.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：主语单数第三人称、陈述客观事实用一般现在时 dates。

classPractice.question: All these trees are over 800 years old, with some ____ (date) back to 1,000 years ago.
classPractice.note: PPT原题：with 复合结构中 some 与 date 是主动关系，用现在分词 dating。

classPractice.question: All the photographs in this book, unless stated otherwise, date ____ the 1950s.
classPractice.note: PPT原题：date from = date back to"追溯到"，此处固定用介词 from。

classPractice.question: 有证据表明针灸可以追溯到石器时代。
classPractice.answer: There is evidence that acupuncture dates back to the Stone Age.
classPractice.note: 回译课件原句；date back to 不用进行时。

translation: 【课件】（疼痛、天气、后果等）十分严重的，剧烈的，极为恶劣的；【课件】（惩罚、批评等）严厉的；【课件】（考验、任务等）艰难的，严峻的
original_sentence: Acupuncture can be used to treat many conditions, including severe pains, blood pressure issues, stomach discomfort, sports injuries and weight problems.
definitionEn: very bad, serious or unpleasant; or strict and harsh in the way people are treated.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人或态度）严厉的，严格的（be severe with sb 对某人严厉）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher was severe with any student who cheated.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 艰难的，严峻的（需要巨大努力和技巧）
uncommonMeanings.example: The marathon is a severe test of stamina.

posExamples.example: The patient was suffering from severe pain in his back.
posExamples.translation: 这位病人后背剧痛难忍。

collocations.translation: 剧烈的疼痛（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Acupuncture is often used to relieve severe pains.
The flight was cancelled because of severe weather conditions.
He received a severe punishment for breaking the rules.

collocations.translation: 对某人/自己严厉（课件：be severe with oneself 严于律己）
collocations.example: A good leader is severe with himself but kind to others.
The marathon is a severe test of stamina.

collocations.translation: 遭到惨败/蒙受重大损失（课件）
collocations.example: The company suffered severe losses last year.

synonyms.example: He is in hospital with a serious illness.
synonyms.usage: adj.；通用词，指程度重、后果重；severe 语气更强，多修饰 pain/weather/punishment。

synonyms.example: The workers lived under harsh conditions.
synonyms.usage: adj.；侧重环境/待遇严酷刺骨，与 severe 表"严厉"义相近。

synonyms.example: Our school has strict rules about uniforms.
synonyms.usage: adj.；指规则/要求严格，be strict with sb 与 be severe with sb 相近但语气略缓。

advancedExpressions.expression: severe (adj. 严重/严厉) → severely (adv. 严重地) → severity (n. 严重性)
advancedExpressions.example: Areas severely affected by unemployment show the severity of the problem.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The pain was very bad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The patient was suffering from severe pain, which acupuncture helped to relieve.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 severe 替换 very bad，并加非限制性定语从句衔接治疗话题。

classPractice.question: 班主任老师用严厉的声音说道。（The head teacher spoke ...）
classPractice.answer: The head teacher spoke in a severe voice.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：severe 此处表"严厉的"，in a severe voice。

classPractice.question: 这是一所专门为学习上有严重困难的孩子们开设的学校。（This is a school ...）
classPractice.answer: This is a school for children with severe learning difficulties.
classPractice.note: PPT原题：severe learning difficulties"严重的学习困难"。

classPractice.question: The disease is spreading fast, and doctors are worried about its ____ (severe).
classPractice.note: 空处作 about 的宾语，需名词 severity"严重性"。

classPractice.question: Some coastal areas were ____ (severe) hit by the storm last week.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 hit，用副词 severely"严重地"。

translation: 【课件】焦虑，忧虑，担心（anxiety about/over sth）；【课件】渴望，热望（anxiety to do sth）
original_sentence: Acupuncture is also believed to help patients cope with stress and anxiety.
definitionEn: a feeling of worry or nervousness, especially about something that might happen; also a strong wish to do something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 渴望，热望（an anxiety to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: He has a strong anxiety to win in the race.

posExamples.example: Children normally feel a lot of anxiety on their first day at school.
posExamples.translation: 孩子们上学第一天通常会感到很焦虑。

wordForms.meaning: 焦虑的；渴望的（be anxious about/for/to do）

collocations.example: Children normally feel a lot of anxiety about their first day at school.
He has a strong anxiety to win in the race.

collocations.translation: 应对/缓解焦虑（话题搭配）
collocations.example: Regular exercise can help relieve anxiety and stress.

collocations.translation: 为……担心（形容词搭配，课件）
collocations.example: Parents are naturally anxious about their children.

collocations.phrase: be anxious to do sth / for sb to do sth
collocations.example: Why was she so anxious for me to stay?

synonyms.example: Her main worry is that she may lose her job.
synonyms.usage: n./v.；日常用词，程度较轻；anxiety 更正式，可含"紧张不安"的心理状态。

synonyms.example: There is growing concern about the safety of the food.
synonyms.usage: n.；侧重对某问题的关切，语气较客观、中性。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be anxious 从句用 should
advancedExpressions.expression: be anxious + that 从句时，从句谓语常用"should + 动词原形"（should 可省略）：I'm anxious that we (should) get there on time.
advancedExpressions.example: The teacher was anxious that every student (should) hand in the paper on time.

advancedExpressions.expression: be anxious about/for sth (为…担心) ｜ be anxious to do sth / for sb to do sth (渴望…) ｜ be anxious + that 从句(should do)
advancedExpressions.example: Anxious about the exam, she was also anxious to prove herself.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The students were worried before the exam.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Filled with anxiety before the exam, the students could hardly sit still.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 anxiety 名词化，配过去分词短语作状语，句式更书面。

classPractice.question: 为什么她那么渴望我留下？Why was she so ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (anxious)?
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：be anxious for sb to do sth"渴望某人做某事"。

classPractice.question: I'm anxious that ____ (我们应该准时到达那里) because I don't think there'll be many seats left.
classPractice.answer: we should get there on time
classPractice.note: PPT原题：be anxious that 从句谓语用"should + 动词原形"。

classPractice.question: Children normally feel a lot of ____ (焦虑) their first day at school.
classPractice.note: PPT原题：anxiety about sth"对……的焦虑"。

classPractice.question: Parents are naturally ____ (anxiety) about the safety of their children.
classPractice.note: be + ____ + about 需形容词 anxious"担心的"。

translation: 【课件】v. 滥用（abuse one's power）；【课件】v. 虐待；【课件】v. 辱骂；【课件】n. /əˈbjuːs/ 滥用；虐待；辱骂
original_sentence: Acupuncture has also been applied to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
definitionEn: to use something in a wrong or harmful way; to treat a person or animal cruelly; or to speak rudely to someone.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （发音 /əˈbjuːs/）滥用；虐待；辱骂（drug abuse 嗜毒；child abuse 虐待儿童）
uncommonMeanings.example: What she did was an abuse of her position as manager.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 辱骂，抨击
uncommonMeanings.example: The referee had been threatened and abused by angry fans.

posExamples.example: He showed how the rich and powerful can abuse their position.
posExamples.translation: 他揭示了有钱有势的人如何会滥用自己的地位。

posExamples.example: Rose said she had been a victim of child abuse.
posExamples.translation: 罗丝说她曾是虐待儿童的受害者。

collocations.translation: 嗜酒/嗜烟/嗜毒；滥用……（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Acupuncture has been used to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
He showed how the rich and powerful can abuse their position.
By lying to us, he abused our trust.

collocations.translation: 虐待儿童/嗜毒（课件名词搭配）
collocations.example: The organization works to protect children from child abuse.

collocations.translation: 精神/身体上的虐待（课件：mental abuse）
collocations.example: He suffered years of mental abuse.

synonyms.example: The misuse of antibiotics can be dangerous.
synonyms.usage: vt./n.；侧重"用错、不当使用"，语气较中性；abuse 更强，含有害或不道德意味。

synonyms.example: The animals had been badly mistreated by their owner.
synonyms.usage: vt.；与 abuse"虐待"义相近，指对人或动物残忍对待。

synonyms.example: He insulted the waiter and then walked out.
synonyms.usage: vt./n.；与 abuse"辱骂"义相近，侧重言语上的侮辱。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·abuse 名动同形异音
advancedExpressions.expression: abuse 作动词读 /əˈbjuːz/，作名词读 /əˈbjuːs/（词尾 s 清浊变化区分词性），类似 use、excuse、house。
advancedExpressions.example: People who abuse /əˈbjuːz/ their power should be punished for the abuse /əˈbjuːs/.

advancedExpressions.expression: abuse = ①滥用 (abuse one's power) ②虐待 (physically/emotionally abused) ③辱骂 (threatened and abused)
advancedExpressions.example: The manager abused his power and verbally abused his staff.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Some people drink too much alcohol and it harms their health.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Acupuncture has been used to help people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs recover their health.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 abuse 表"嗜/滥用"，一词概括"过量饮酒/吸烟/吸毒"，更凝练。

classPractice.question: 写出画线词的词性和中文释义：Rose said she had been a victim of child abuse. ____ ____
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：child abuse 中 abuse 为名词"虐待"，读 /əˈbjuːs/。

classPractice.question: 写出画线词的词性和中文释义：He showed how the rich and powerful can abuse their position. ____ ____
classPractice.note: PPT原题：abuse their position 中 abuse 为动词"滥用"，读 /əˈbjuːz/。

classPractice.question: 写出画线词的词性和中文释义：What she did was an abuse of her position as manager. ____ ____
classPractice.note: PPT原题：an abuse of 中 abuse 为名词"滥用"。

classPractice.question: 写出画线词的词性和中文释义：When the police found the children, they had been abused physically and emotionally. ____ ____
classPractice.note: PPT原题：be abused 中 abuse 为动词"虐待"。

translation: 【课件】酒，含酒精的饮料；酒精，乙醇
original_sentence: Acupuncture has also been applied to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
definitionEn: drinks such as beer, wine, etc. that can make people drunk; the chemical substance in these drinks.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 酒精，乙醇（一种化学物质）
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor cleaned the wound with alcohol before applying the bandage.

posExamples.example: Doctors advise patients with liver disease to give up alcohol completely.
posExamples.translation: 医生建议肝病患者彻底戒酒。

collocations.example: Acupuncture has been used to help people who abuse alcohol.
He decided to give up alcohol for the sake of his health.
Driving under the influence of alcohol is strictly prohibited.
The bar also serves alcohol-free drinks for drivers.

synonyms.example: Selling liquor to people under 18 is against the law.
synonyms.usage: liquor 多指烈性酒(spirits)，不可数；alcohol 泛指一切含酒精饮料，也指化学物质酒精。

advancedExpressions.expression: abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs / be addicted to alcohol
advancedExpressions.example: Programmes have been set up to help teenagers who are addicted to alcohol.

advancedExpressions.expression: alcohol-free = alcohol + free（不含…的），类比 sugar-free / fat-free / duty-free
advancedExpressions.example: Many young people now prefer alcohol-free beer.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The clinic treats people who drink too much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The clinic treats people who abuse alcohol, offering both medical and psychological support.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 abuse alcohol 提升，呼应课件原句表达。

classPractice.question: Acupuncture has also been applied to treat people who ____ alcohol, tobacco or drugs. (滥用)
classPractice.note: 课件原句：abuse alcohol/tobacco/drugs 表示嗜酒/嗜烟/嗜毒。

classPractice.question: 为了健康，他决定彻底戒酒。(give up)
classPractice.answer: For the sake of his health, he decided to give up alcohol completely.
classPractice.note: give up alcohol = 戒酒；for the sake of 为了。

classPractice.question: Driving under the influence ____ alcohol can lead to serious accidents.
classPractice.note: under the influence of alcohol 醉酒/受酒精影响，固定介词 of。

translation: 【课件】烟草，烟叶；烟丝
original_sentence: Acupuncture has also been applied to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
definitionEn: the dried leaves of the tobacco plant that people smoke in cigarettes, cigars and pipes.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 烟草制品业；烟草公司（常作定语，如 the tobacco industry）
uncommonMeanings.example: The tobacco industry has faced growing pressure over public health.

posExamples.example: Smoking tobacco greatly increases the risk of lung cancer.
posExamples.translation: 吸食烟草会大大增加患肺癌的风险。

wordForms.meaning: 烟草（作物质名词通常不可数）

collocations.example: Acupuncture may help those who abuse tobacco to quit.
The tobacco industry spends huge sums on advertising.
Farmers in this region have grown tobacco for generations.
The government passed a strict tobacco control law to protect young people.

advancedExpressions.expression: abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs / ban on tobacco advertising
advancedExpressions.example: Many countries have imposed a ban on tobacco advertising.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people smoke and it harms their health.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The widespread abuse of tobacco continues to pose a serious threat to public health.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 abuse of tobacco + pose a threat to 提升表达。

classPractice.question: Acupuncture has been used to treat people who abuse alcohol, ____ or drugs. (烟草)
classPractice.note: 课件原句并列结构 alcohol, tobacco or drugs。

classPractice.question: 政府通过了严格的法规来限制烟草广告。(tobacco advertising)
classPractice.answer: The government passed strict regulations to restrict tobacco advertising.
classPractice.note: tobacco 常作定语修饰 advertising/industry。

classPractice.question: Smoking ____ (tobacco/alcohol) greatly increases the risk of lung cancer.
classPractice.note: 抽烟对象是烟草 tobacco，非 alcohol。

translation: 【课件】毒品；【课件】药，药物；vt. 使服药，给…下药
original_sentence: Acupuncture has also been applied to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
definitionEn: a substance used as a medicine to treat illness; also an illegal substance that people take for its effect on the body or mind.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 药，药物（medicine）
uncommonMeanings.example: The drug was withdrawn from sale after a number of people suffered serious side effects.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给…用药；下药（使昏睡等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The victim had been drugged before the robbery.

posExamples.example: Scientists are developing new drugs to fight cancer.
posExamples.translation: 科学家正在研发治疗癌症的新药。

posExamples.example: They drugged the guard dog so that they could break in.
posExamples.translation: 他们给看门狗下药，好破门而入。

collocations.translation: 吸毒；滥用药物（课件原句）
collocations.example: Acupuncture has been applied to help people who abuse drugs.
The patient is on several drugs to control the pain.
Drug abuse can destroy both health and family life.
The new drug proved effective in treating the virus.
The drug was withdrawn from sale after serious side effects appeared.

synonyms.example: Take this medicine three times a day after meals.
synonyms.usage: medicine 中性指治病的药，不可数(泛指)可数(具体一种)；drug 既指药也指毒品，语境定褒贬。

advancedExpressions.expression: abuse alcohol, tobacco or drugs / take drugs / drug addiction
advancedExpressions.example: The centre helps young people recover from drug addiction.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The medicine was taken off the market because it was unsafe.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The drug was withdrawn from sale after a number of people suffered serious side effects.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 withdraw a drug from sale + side effects 提升，源自 Grammar 课件例句。

classPractice.question: Acupuncture has been applied to treat people who abuse alcohol, tobacco or ____. (毒品)
classPractice.note: 课件原句，此处指毒品，用复数 drugs。

classPractice.question: The doctor prescribed a new ____ (drug / weapon) to control his blood pressure.
classPractice.note: 此处 drug = 药物 medicine。

classPractice.question: 这种药因严重副作用被停售了。(withdraw ... from sale)
classPractice.answer: The drug was withdrawn from sale because of its serious side effects.
classPractice.note: withdraw sth from sale 停售；被动语态。

translation: 现象；（尤指不寻常或非凡的）事件，人物
original_sentence: The growing use of acupuncture around the world is a phenomenon that has attracted the attention of many Western doctors.
definitionEn: a fact or an event in nature or society, especially one that is not fully understood; also a very remarkable person or thing.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 非凡的人（或事物）；奇才
uncommonMeanings.example: As a young surgeon, she was regarded as a medical phenomenon.

posExamples.example: Fever is a common phenomenon when the body is fighting an infection.
posExamples.translation: 发烧是身体对抗感染时的常见现象。

collocations.example: Ageing is a natural phenomenon that affects everyone.

collocations.translation: 一种普遍／广泛存在的现象
collocations.example: Obesity has become a widespread phenomenon among children.
Scientists are still trying to explain this strange phenomenon.
The spread of the virus quickly became a global phenomenon.

synonyms.example: Earthquakes are a rare occurrence in this region.
synonyms.usage: phenomenon 强调值得注意/待解释的现象，复数 phenomena；occurrence 泛指发生的事，中性。

advancedExpressions.expression: phenomenon(单) → phenomena(复)，源自希腊语，类比 criterion→criteria, medium→media
advancedExpressions.example: These phenomena are difficult to explain scientifically.

advancedExpressions.expression: phenomenon(n.) → phenomenal(adj. 非凡的) → phenomenally(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The treatment achieved phenomenal success.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people now use acupuncture, and this is interesting.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The growing use of acupuncture worldwide is a phenomenon that has drawn wide attention.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a phenomenon that... 定语从句把普通陈述升级为学术表达。

classPractice.question: Several strange ____ (phenomenon) in the sky were reported by different observers.
classPractice.note: several 后接可数名词复数，phenomenon 的复数是 phenomena。

classPractice.question: Obesity is very common among children now. → Obesity has become a widespread ____ among children.
classPractice.note: a widespread phenomenon 一种普遍现象。

classPractice.question: The treatment was so effective that it achieved ____ (phenomenon) success.
classPractice.note: 此处修饰名词 success，用形容词 phenomenal 非凡的。

translation: 【课件】物质 (C)；【课件】事实依据 (U)；【课件】要点，实质
original_sentence: Some herbs contain a chemical substance that can relieve pain and reduce infection.
definitionEn: a particular type of material with definite properties; also the real or important part or meaning of something; solid basis in fact.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 事实依据；真实性（U，常用 without substance / no substance）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was rumour, completely without substance.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 要点，实质，主旨
uncommonMeanings.example: I agreed with what she said in substance, though not with every detail.

posExamples.example: Water is a substance made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
posExamples.translation: 水是由氢和氧构成的一种物质。

wordForms.meaning: 大量的；重大的，价值巨大的

collocations.example: The plant produces a chemical substance that kills bacteria.
It was rumour, completely without substance.
There is no substance in any of these accusations.
I agreed with what she said in substance, though not with every detail.
The factory released harmful substances into the river.

synonyms.example: Doctors switched from bamboo to metal materials for the needles.
synonyms.usage: substance 侧重具有特定性质的物质(化学/科学语境)；material 侧重制造用的材料。

advancedExpressions.expression: substance(n.) → substantial(adj. 重大的/大量的) → substantially(adv. 大大地)（课件）
advancedExpressions.example: The costs have increased substantially. / substantial sums of money

advancedExpressions.expression: without substance = groundless = have no basis in fact = there is no substance in sth
advancedExpressions.example: The claim was dismissed as being completely without substance.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The story is not true at all.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The story is a mere rumour, completely without substance.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 without substance 表达'毫无事实根据'，源自课件用法。

classPractice.question: It was rumour, completely without ____; there is no proof at all. (substance)
classPractice.note: 课件：without substance = 没有事实根据。

classPractice.question: The costs of the project have increased ____ (substance) over the past year.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 increased，用副词 substantially 大大地。

classPractice.question: 我基本上同意她说的话，尽管细节上有出入。(in substance)
classPractice.answer: I agreed with what she said in substance, though not with every detail.
classPractice.note: in substance 本质上/基本上，课件短语。

translation: 【课件】象征，标志；【课件】符号，代号
original_sentence: Acupuncture is recognized as a symbol of traditional Chinese culture and has come into widespread use around the world.
definitionEn: a person, object or event that represents a more general quality or situation; also a sign, letter or mark that stands for something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 符号，代号（数学、化学等中的记号）
uncommonMeanings.example: What's the chemical symbol for iron?

posExamples.example: The dove is a symbol of peace all over the world.
posExamples.translation: 鸽子是世界各地的和平象征。

collocations.example: The dove is a symbol of peace.

collocations.phrase: be recognized as a symbol of ...
collocations.translation: 被视为…的象征（课件原句）
collocations.example: Acupuncture is recognized as a symbol of traditional Chinese culture.
What's the chemical symbol for iron?
For some people a luxury car is a status symbol.

synonyms.example: Scientists have found no sign of life on Mars so far.
synonyms.usage: symbol 侧重代表抽象意义的象征物；sign 侧重迹象/告示/记号；signal 信号；mark 记号/标记，课件辨析题按此选。

advancedExpressions.expression: symbol(n.) → symbolize(vt. 象征) → symbolic(adj. 象征性的)（课件）
advancedExpressions.example: Red symbolizes / is symbolic of good luck in many cultures.

advancedExpressions.expression: no sign of life（迹象）/ a busy signal（信号）/ put a mark by（记号）/ a symbol of strength（象征）
advancedExpressions.example: I frequently use sunflowers as a symbol of strength.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Red means good luck in many cultures.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Red is a symbol of good luck in many cultures.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 be a symbol of / symbolize 提升，源自课件填空练习。

classPractice.question: 用 symbol, sign, signal 或 mark 填空：Scientists have found no ____ of life on Mars so far.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：no sign of life，sign 指迹象。

classPractice.question: 用 symbol, sign, signal 或 mark 填空：I frequently use sunflowers as a ____ of strength.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：a symbol of strength，象征。

classPractice.question: Red ____ (symbol) good luck in many Chinese cultures.
classPractice.note: 课件答案：symbolized/symbolizes，此处主语单数、一般现在时用 symbolizes。

translation: 【课件】分布广的；普遍的，广泛的
original_sentence: Acupuncture is recognized as a symbol of traditional Chinese culture and has come into widespread use around the world.
definitionEn: existing or happening over a large area or among many people.

posExamples.example: There is widespread concern about the misuse of new medical technology.
posExamples.translation: 人们对新医疗技术被滥用有着广泛的担忧。

wordForms.meaning: 广泛地，普遍地（相关副词）

collocations.translation: 得到广泛使用（课件原句）
collocations.example: Acupuncture has come into widespread use around the world.
The high cost prohibits the widespread use of the drug.
The new gene technology has caused widespread concern.

collocations.translation: 普遍现象／广泛流行的疾病
collocations.example: Flu is a widespread disease in winter.

synonyms.example: Fever is a common symptom of infection.
synonyms.usage: widespread 强调分布地域广/波及人多；common 强调常见、司空见惯，二者不完全等同。

advancedExpressions.expression: widespread = wide + spread（广泛铺开的），类比 widespread panic / widespread damage
advancedExpressions.example: The storm caused widespread damage across the region.

advancedExpressions.expression: come into widespread use / gain widespread acceptance / be widely used
advancedExpressions.example: The technique has gained widespread acceptance among doctors.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Acupuncture is used a lot around the world now.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Acupuncture has come into widespread use around the world.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 come into widespread use 提升，源自课件原句。

classPractice.question: Acupuncture is recognized as a symbol of Chinese culture and has come into ____ use around the world. (广泛的)
classPractice.note: 课件原句：come into widespread use。

classPractice.question: 这种药昂贵的价格阻碍了它的广泛使用。(prohibit the widespread use of)
classPractice.answer: The high cost prohibits the widespread use of the drug.
classPractice.note: 课件例句：the widespread use of the drug。

classPractice.question: 选 widespread / wide 填空：Smartphones are now in ____ use, from small villages to big cities. (广泛的)
classPractice.note: in widespread use 得到广泛使用，强调分布广、波及人多，呼应课件 come into widespread use。

translation: 绷带；vt. 用绷带包扎
original_sentence: When someone is bleeding, you should press a clean bandage firmly on the wound to stop the flow of blood.
definitionEn: a long narrow piece of cloth used to cover or tie around a wound or an injured part of the body.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 用绷带包扎（伤口、身体部位）
uncommonMeanings.example: The nurse bandaged his injured arm before sending him to the doctor.

posExamples.example: The first-aid kit contains bandages, scissors and antiseptic cream.
posExamples.translation: 急救箱里有绷带、剪刀和消毒药膏。

posExamples.example: She quickly bandaged the wound to stop the bleeding.
posExamples.translation: 她迅速包扎伤口以止血。

wordForms.meaning: 绷带；用绷带包扎（名动同形）

collocations.example: Apply a clean bandage to the wound at once.
The doctor wrapped a bandage around his ankle.
Keep the bandage over the wound dry and clean.
The nurse changes the bandage twice a day to prevent infection.

synonyms.example: The nurse applied a sterile dressing to the burn.
synonyms.usage: bandage 是缠绕固定用的长条绷带；dressing 是直接盖住伤口的敷料，二者常配合使用。

advancedExpressions.expression: apply a bandage / wrap a bandage around / stop the bleeding / clean the wound
advancedExpressions.example: First clean the wound, then apply a bandage to stop the bleeding.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: She put something on the cut to stop the blood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She pressed a clean bandage firmly on the cut to stop the bleeding.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 press a bandage on + stop the bleeding 使急救描述更专业。

classPractice.question: The nurse ____ (bandage) his injured leg carefully before he was taken to hospital.
classPractice.note: bandage 可作及物动词'包扎'，此处一般过去时。

classPractice.question: 有人流血时，你应把干净的绷带紧压在伤口上以止血。(bandage)
classPractice.answer: When someone is bleeding, you should press a clean bandage firmly on the wound to stop the bleeding.
classPractice.note: press a bandage on the wound 压绷带于伤口。

classPractice.question: First aid: clean the cut, then ____ a bandage to keep out dirt. (敷上)
classPractice.note: apply a bandage 敷上绷带。

translation: 感染，传染；传染病
original_sentence: Cleaning a wound properly and covering it with a clean bandage can help prevent infection.
definitionEn: the process of causing a disease by germs entering the body; an illness caused by germs, bacteria or viruses.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 传染病，感染性疾病（可数，指具体的病）
uncommonMeanings.example: A chest infection kept her in bed for a week.

posExamples.example: A healthy diet should help your body resist infection.
posExamples.translation: 健康饮食有助于身体抗感染。

collocations.example: Washing your hands often helps prevent infection.

collocations.translation: 抵抗感染（课件相关搭配）
collocations.example: A healthy diet should help your body resist infection.
The child was treated for an ear infection.
Isolating patients can stop the spread of infection.

synonyms.example: Genome editing may help prevent certain diseases from developing.
synonyms.usage: infection 特指由病菌/病毒进入体内引起的感染或传染病；disease 泛指各类疾病(含非传染性)。

advancedExpressions.expression: infect(vt.) → infection(n.) → infectious(adj. 传染性的) / infected(adj. 受感染的)
advancedExpressions.example: Flu is a highly infectious disease.

advancedExpressions.expression: prevent / resist / fight infection / reduce infection
advancedExpressions.example: Some herbs can relieve pain and reduce infection.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: If you keep the wound clean, you won't get sick from it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Keeping the wound clean and covered can help prevent infection.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 prevent infection 使表达更符合医学语境。

classPractice.question: A healthy diet should help your body resist ____ (infect).
classPractice.note: resist 后接名词，infect 的名词形式为 infection。

classPractice.question: Flu is a highly ____ (infect) disease that spreads quickly in winter.
classPractice.note: 修饰 disease，用形容词 infectious 传染性的。

classPractice.question: 妥善清洁伤口并盖上干净的绷带有助于预防感染。(prevent infection)
classPractice.answer: Cleaning a wound properly and covering it with a clean bandage can help prevent infection.
classPractice.note: prevent infection 预防感染。

translation: 部门；（大学的）系，学部；（大商店的）部
original_sentence: If your condition is serious, the nurse will send you to the emergency department of the hospital at once.
definitionEn: a section of a large organization such as a hospital, government, university or shop.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （政府的）部；（大学的）系
uncommonMeanings.example: She works in the Department of Health as a policy adviser.

posExamples.example: The emergency department deals with patients who need urgent treatment.
posExamples.translation: 急诊科负责处理需要紧急治疗的病人。

collocations.example: He was rushed to the emergency department after the accident.
Each hospital department is run by a senior doctor.
She teaches in the Department of Medicine at the university.
You can buy first-aid kits at any large department store.

synonyms.example: This section of the hospital treats children only.
synonyms.usage: department 多指机构中独立运作的部门/科室/系；section 指更小的组成部分或区段。

advancedExpressions.expression: the emergency department / the outpatient department / the department of surgery
advancedExpressions.example: Patients with minor injuries are seen in the outpatient department.

advancedExpressions.expression: depart(vi. 离开) → departure(n. 离开) / department(n. 部门) → departmental(adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: The proposal was approved at a departmental meeting.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: If it is serious, the nurse will take you to the hospital part for urgent cases.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If your condition is serious, the nurse will send you to the emergency department at once.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 the emergency department 使医院场景描述更准确。

classPractice.question: The patient was seriously injured and was rushed to the emergency ____ of the hospital. (科室)
classPractice.note: the emergency department 急诊科。

classPractice.question: 她在这所大学的医学系任教。(the Department of Medicine)
classPractice.answer: She teaches in the Department of Medicine at this university.
classPractice.note: the Department of + 学科 表示大学的'…系'。

classPractice.question: You can buy a first-aid kit at any large ____ store. (department / section)
classPractice.note: department store 百货商店，固定搭配。
